notes.title: Fixed some small things..
notes.content:
Fixed some small things.. in particular the achievement at the end of the game was not unlocked, if you have finished the game and you have not canceled the save you can click on "continue" to do the last piece and now the achievement should unlock depending on the ending.

I haven't encountered any bugs in my previous tests but it's amazing how many things players can do that I never thought of doing in the in tests.. serious bugs shouldn't be there anyway but be patient, if you find something report it and I'll fix it.

(for anything you can post in the hub) 
Thanks,
Edd
